Don't Miss This Open House in Copperas Cove | Sunday 1–4 PM #openhouse 

🏡 Open House This Sunday in Copperas Cove!
📍 1818 Castroville Trail, Copperas Cove, TX
🗓 Sunday | 1:00–4:00 PM
🎉 Hosted by listing agent Kati Bennett

Looking for your next home in Copperas Cove? Come tour this beautiful property in the sought-after Heartwood Park area! With spacious living, modern finishes, and a welcoming layout, this home offers comfort, convenience, and style—all in one.

✨ Highlights include:
✔️ Open-concept floor plan
✔️ Stylish kitchen and spacious bedrooms
✔️ Fenced backyard perfect for gatherings or pets
✔️ Easy access to Fort Hood, schools, and shopping

Whether you're buying your first home or upgrading your space, this one is worth the visit.
